sentences.text: Health visitor Bethan Lloyd (S1) stated she spoke to Kayleigh Morris (S2) on the phone on Friday.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) described the home environment as messy and stated it had been 'a bit mad'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed the presence of a twelve-day-old baby named Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she is at home with her husband, Dean, who works early shifts at a warehouse and is back at three o'clock.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the relationship with Dean is 'fine' but 'normal' and 'bit tense with no sleep'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she is breastfeeding mostly, but provides one bottle of formula at night because she is tired.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the baby feeds every two or two and a half hours during the day, and sometimes wants to feed all evening.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the baby has 'loads' of wet and dirty nappies, specifically six or seven wet ones.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the midwife weighed the baby on day five at three point two kilos.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported her physical recovery from birth is 'bit sore still but better'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported her mood has been 'up and down' and she 'cries a lot'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported her sister said crying is normal.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the baby weighed three point four one kilos.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the baby is sleeping in the Moses basket next to their bed on her back.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she is worried about the formula the baby is drinking.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) disclosed that Dean pushed her into a wardrobe door during an argument.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean has pushed her 'three or four times' since the summer.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) disclosed that in August, when she was about thirty weeks pregnant, Dean punched her in the stomach.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she went to the hospital the day after the punching because the baby was not moving much, but told the hospital she had fallen.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed the punching incident happened only once.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean checks her phone every night and goes through all her messages.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean gets angry if she messages someone he does not like.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean will not let her see her mum, stating she is a 'bad influence'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she last saw her mum in September, before Ruby was born, and her mum has not met the baby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed Dean has never hurt or been rough with Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she feels safe at home today because Dean is at work until three o'clock.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) agreed to refer herself to Harbridge Women's Aid, suggesting her sister Kirsty's number.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean deals with money and she has applied for child benefit but does not have her own bank card.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed Ruby's birth was registered last Tuesday.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed her GP is Dr Anand.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed her sister's number is seven seven [digits omitted in transcript] and agreed to provide it for the GP six-week check notification.
Bethan Lloyd (S1) stated she will make a Women's Aid referral today, and the service will ring Kirsty's phone by Friday.
Bethan Lloyd (S1) stated she will speak to the safeguarding lead today and inform Dr Anand (the GP).
Bethan Lloyd (S1) stated she will return on Thursday the third of December at eleven o'clock.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed she would call 999 if she is ever in danger.
